defect_observations: Suspected inconsistency (not a coverage gap): the ND definition (inherited-02193-02340.tex:27-29) says there is no repetition step and 'the tree reuses the node already present', but the Commutativity example (88-101) cites line 1 twice. A node used as the premise of two inferences makes a DAG, not a tree. The inactive old figure fig:p02-nd-tree uses two separate leaf occurrences instead.
A-115 is met on the route only by an NJ (intuitionistic) tree in P7 (fig:p07-stlc-nd-derivation), not by a classical ND_CPL tree in the chapter that owns classical ND.
The Excluded-middle example cites ch:intuitionistic-logic as making ND-minus-RAA 'exact', but that chapter's calculus is LJ with defined negation; the named ND calculus is never made exact there.
Duplicate label fig:p07-stlc-nd-derivation also exists in handbook/parts/p07/normalization-and-curry-howard.tex:354. That file is not \input on the route, so the build has no duplicate.
